html:
Question 3
?

Express the following arithmetic series using sigma notation.

1+53+73+…+373+13

a
∑n=119(53n+13)
b
∑n=119(23n+13)
c
∑n=119(53n+1)
d
∑n=119(23n+1)
e
∑n=119(23n+43)
